testcases.name: fast-foundation-stereo
testcases.notes: Fixed 700x700 realistic rectified stereo inference through the native C++ runtime. The pinned official PyTorch model receives the identical repo-owned office pair; the gate requires shape, finiteness, non-negative disparity, flattened FP32 cosine similarity >= 0.999, mean endpoint error <= 0.5 px, and bad-2px fraction <= 0.03.
